introduction: Cecilia Lee is a Canadian actress, model, and digital creator known for her work in film and television. She has appeared in notable projects including the Netflix TV series Fear Street: Prom Queen (2025), the TV series Wong & Winchester (2023), and the TV movie My Dreams of You (2024). Lee has also contributed behind the scenes in the camera and electrical department, showcasing a multifaceted involvement in the entertainment industry.Her early career began with acting roles in short films and TV movies such as The Holiday Swap (2022) and Travel With Us (2021), where she earned recognition including a Best Actress award at the 2021 48 Hour Film Festival. Lee has trained extensively in acting, including Meisner and on-camera workshops, and has developed skills in stage combat, dialects, and voiceover work. She is also an accomplished musician and athlete, reflecting a broad artistic and physical discipline.Lee's impact extends beyond acting; she has worked as a camera assistant on various projects, demonstrating technical expertise that complements her on-screen presence. Her performances have contributed to diverse storytelling in contemporary media, and her involvement in both creative and technical roles highlights her versatility within the industry. Represented by Glenn Talent Management, Lee continues to build a varied portfolio that bridges acting, modeling, and digital content creation, influencing pop culture through her dynamic participation in entertainment.
